28	 * Every numeric field on this page is a free-text box that an operator types into
29	 * once, at speed, usually during an incident — and several of them multiply money
30	 * or gate an irreversible action. The two failures this codebase has already shipped

349	 * (`saveSettings.bind(null, "general")`) so it's never client-supplied; React's
350	 * useActionState then supplies (prevState, formData).
351	 */
352	export async function saveSettings(
353	  section: string,
354	  _prev: Result | undefined,
355	  formData: FormData,
356	): Promise<Result> {
357	  const fields = SECTION_FIELDS[section];
358	  if (!fields) return { error: "Unknown settings section." };
359	
360	  const area = BILLING_SECTIONS.has(section) ? "billing" : "platform";
361	  const user = await requireArea(area);
362	
363	  const changes: { key: string; value: string }[] = [];
364	
365	  for (const f of fields) {
366	    const raw = formData.get(f.key);
367	
368	    if (f.type === "bool") {
369	      changes.push({ key: f.key, value: raw ? "true" : "false" });
370	      continue;
371	    }
372	
373	    if (f.type === "secret") {
374	      const v = (raw ?? "").toString();
375	      if (v.trim() === "") continue; // never clear/overwrite a stored secret with blank
376	      // Encrypt at rest. `smtp_pass` was the last secret in the DB stored as
377	      // plaintext while mailbox passwords and the Cloudflare token both use the
378	      // AES-256-GCM box. Read-back in lib/mailer.ts decrypts, tolerating a legacy
379	      // plaintext row until it is next saved. Never render — SecretField shows
380	      // only `isSet` — so this closes an at-rest exposure, not a live leak.
381	      changes.push({ key: f.key, value: encryptSecret(v) });
382	      continue;
383	    }
384	
385	    if (f.type === "enum") {
386	      const s = (raw ?? "").toString().trim();
387	      if (s === "") {
388	        changes.push({ key: f.key, value: SETTINGS_DEFAULTS[f.key as keyof typeof SETTINGS_DEFAULTS] ?? "" });
389	        continue;
390	      }
391	      // A <select> constrains the browser, not the request.
392	      if (!f.values?.includes(s)) {
393	        return { error: `“${f.key}” must be one of: ${f.values?.join(", ")}.` };
394	      }
395	      changes.push({ key: f.key, value: s });
396	      continue;
397	    }
398	
399	    if (f.type === "int" || f.type === "num") {
400	      const s = (raw ?? "").toString().trim();
401	      if (s === "") {
402	        changes.push({ key: f.key, value: SETTINGS_DEFAULTS[f.key as keyof typeof SETTINGS_DEFAULTS] ?? "0" });
403	        continue;
404	      }
405	      const n = Number(s);
406	      if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return { error: `“${f.key}” must be a number.` };
407	      // Refuse rather than clamp, so the stored row always equals what the operator
408	      // can read back off the field. Silent clamping is how a panel ends up showing
409	      // one number while the platform enforces another.
410	      if (f.min !== undefined && n < f.min) {
411	        return { error: `“${f.key}” must be at least ${f.min} (you entered ${s}).` };
412	      }
413	      if (f.max !== undefined && n > f.max) {
414	        return { error: `“${f.key}” must be ${f.max} or less (you entered ${s}).` };
415	      }
416	      changes.push({ key: f.key, value: f.type === "int" ? String(Math.round(n)) : String(n) });

487	    const maxAgeDays = num("dormant_winback_max_age_days");
488	    if (Number.isFinite(delayDays) && Number.isFinite(maxAgeDays) && maxAgeDays <= delayDays) {
489	      return {

492	    }

498	    changes.map((c) =>
499	      db.setting.upsert({ where: { key: c.key }, update: { value: c.value }, create: { key: c.key, value: c.value } }),

# TOPIC A — Admin portal conventions

## A1. Structure of `/opt/nxeon/app/admin/`

**Routing shape.** Flat-ish App Router directory: 1 layout, 1 error boundary, 1 loading state, ~120 `page.tsx` files across ~85 route dirs. No route groups inside `/admin`.

- `/opt/nxeon/app/admin/layout.tsx` (238 lines) — the only layout.
- `/opt/nxeon/app/admin/error.tsx`, `/opt/nxeon/app/admin/loading.tsx`.
- `/opt/nxeon/app/admin/login/page.tsx` — the one public, unauthenticated route under `/admin` (special-cased at `layout.tsx:91-95` via the `x-pathname` header injected by `/opt/nxeon/middleware.ts`).
- Nested detail routes use `[id]`: `app/admin/nodes/[id]/page.tsx`, `users/[id]`, `servers/[id]`, `invoices/[id]`, `partners/[id]`, `staff/[id]`, `support/[id]`, `dms/[id]`, `agency/prospects/[id]`, `coldemail/campaigns/[id]`, `coldemail/contacts/[id]`.
- Multi-page consoles nest by directory: `coldemail/` (16 pages), `ads/` (4), `agency/` (5), `marketing/` (4+), `accounting/` (2), `seo/` (2), `nodes/` (3 — list / `new` / `[id]`).

**Nav registry: `/opt/nxeon/lib/admin-groups.ts`** (443 lines). This is the single source of truth for admin IA and is deliberately free of server-only imports (`admin-groups.ts:19-21`) so both the server layout and the client sub-tab bar import it.

- Types at `admin-groups.ts:23-45`: `SubTabItem = { label, href }`, `AdminEntry = { key, label, icon, tabs }`, `AdminGroup = { key, label?, entries }`.
- `export const ADMIN_NAV: AdminGroup[]` at `admin-groups.ts:47`.
- **Counts (computed live):** **11 sections**, **28 entries**, **92 routes**. Section keys in order: `start, customers, fleet, revenue, accounting, marketing, coldemail, agency, ads, mail, platform`.
- Helpers: `adminEntries()` `admin-groups.ts:409`, `hrefMatches()` `:418`, `entryForPath()` `:428` (longest-match resolution).
- `tabs[0]` is the entry's landing page and the href the sidebar links to (`admin-groups.ts:33-36`). A single-member entry renders no tab bar.

**How `layout.tsx` consumes it:**
1. Host gate — `adminHostBlocked()` `layout.tsx:10-16`, `NXEON_ADMIN_HOSTS`; wrong host → `notFound()` (`:83`).
2. `/admin/login` bypass (`:91-95`).
3. `realUser()` + `isStaff()` + refuse-while-impersonating (`:97-101`).
4. IP allowlist `adminIpBlocked()` `:39-59` reading setting `allowed_admin_ips`, **fails open** on malformed/undeterminable IP.
5. Staff 2FA enforcement via `getSettingBool("enforce_staff_2fa")` (`:109-111`).
6. **Feature-gated nav sections** (`:117-127`): `HIDDEN_SECTION_FLAGS = { agency: feature_admin_agency, ads: feature_admin_ads }`, filtered out of `ADMIN_NAV` by section `key`.
7. Role filtering per-tab via `canAccessHref(user.role, tab.href)` (`:133-147`), empty entries/sections dropped.
8. Badge counts, each wrapped in `soft()` so a missing table can't break the layout (`:157-188`).
9. Renders `<Shell nav tag="ops" …>` (`/opt/nxeon/components/portal/Shell.tsx`) + `<AdminSubTabs badges allowed />` + `<AdminChatNotifier />`.

**Adding a new admin console** = add an entry (or tab) to `ADMIN_NAV`, add an `HREF_AREA` mapping in `/opt/nxeon/lib/rbac.ts:72-159`, and (optionally) a section-level flag in `HIDDEN_SECTION_FLAGS`.

---

## A2. Best-practice CRUD pattern — `lib/actions-nodes.ts` + `components/admin/NodeForms.tsx`

**Server action signatures — two distinct shapes, used deliberately:**

1. **Form actions (FormData)** — for the add/edit form, consumed by `useActionState`:
   - `addNode(_prev: FormState, formData: FormData): Promise<FormState>` — `actions-nodes.ts:169`
   - `updateNode(_prev: FormState, formData: FormData): Promise<FormState>` — `actions-nodes.ts:195`
2. **Typed-arg actions** — for inline row controls, consumed by `useTransition`:
   - `setNodeEnabled(id: string, enabled: boolean)` — `:229`
   - `setNodeAcceptsProvisions(id, acceptsProvisions)` — `:246`
   - `setNodeStatus(id, status: NodeStatus)` — `:258`
   - `setNodeMonthlyCost(id, rawDollars: string)` — `:278` (raw dollar string on the wire, cents in the DB)
   - `testNode(id): Promise<TestNodeResult>` — `:330`
   - `deleteNode(id)` — `:381`
   - `suggestNodeDefaults(): Promise<NodeDefaults>` — `:38` (server-computed non-colliding defaults for a new row)

**Error return shape.** `type FormState = { error?: string; ok?: boolean }` — `actions-nodes.ts:27`. Every action returns this (never throws for user-facing errors). `TestNodeResult` (`:302-315`) is the one richer shape.

**Validation.** A single zod schema `nodeSchema` (`:56-87`) + a `parseNodeForm(formData)` adapter (`:91-118`) that trims and coerces every field explicitly — the schema never sees raw `FormData`. First issue only is surfaced: `parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid node details."` (`:172`, `:202`). Cross-row invariants live in `validateAgainstExisting(data, selfId?)` (`:124-167`), returning `string | null`.

**Secret-field convention (important, reused across the codebase).** Blank `tokenSecret` / `agentToken` on an edit form means "leave unchanged" — the field is *omitted* from the update rather than written (`:212-218`, schema note `:82-86`). **`next/image` config: there is none.** `/opt/nxeon/next.config.ts` has **no `images` key at all** — no `remotePatterns`, no `domains`, no `formats`, no `deviceSizes`. Every image is either local (`/public/...`) or an `<img>`. A new page family that needs remote images (e.g. Modrinth/CurseForge icon CDNs, `GameMod.iconUrl` at `prisma/schema.prisma:2896`) **will fail** with `next/image` until `images.remotePatterns` is added.

**`next/image` is barely used in marketing** — only 4 files: `components/marketing/ClaudeMark.tsx`, `components/marketing/CompetitorLogo.tsx`, `components/marketing/MarketingFooter.tsx`, `app/(marketing)/about/page.tsx`.

**CSP already allows remote images:** `img-src 'self' data: blob: https:` — `next.config.ts:15`. So raw `<img src="https://…">` works today; only the Next image optimizer is unconfigured.

**`public/` conventions:**
```
public/
  games/           cs2.svg minecraft.svg palworld.png rust.png valheim.png
  games/art/       127 files — <game>_hero.jpg, <game>_logo.png, <game>_poster.jpg
  logos/           competitor/brand logos
  marketing/       about-founders-danang.jpg, auth-wallpaper*.webp, auth-loop.mp4
  blog/  brand/  flags/  nx/  riddle/  dl/
  logo.png  nx-mark.png  favicon.ico  favicon.svg  icon-192.png  icon-512.png  apple-touch-icon.png
```
The `_hero.jpg` / `_logo.png` / `_poster.jpg` triple under `public/games/art/` is the established naming convention for a per-game key-art set — the obvious pattern for a mod-page family to mirror.

**Caching.** `next.config.ts:114-126` explains that this origin has **no CDN**, so specific static paths get `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable` via `headers()` at `:127-133`:
```
/logo.png, /nx-mark.png, /games/art/:path*, /logos/:path*
```
**A new image directory gets `max-age=0` by default** — add it to that `headers()` list.

**OG image generation.**
- **One** dynamic OG image: `/opt/nxeon/app/opengraph-image.tsx` — `ImageResponse` from `next/og`, `size = {1200, 630}` `:4`, `contentType = "image/png"` `:5`. Static brand card, Satori-compatible flexbox + inline styles only (`:7`). It is at the **app root**, so it applies to every route that doesn't override it.
- **There is no per-route or dynamic-param OG image.** No `app/(marketing)/[slug]/opengraph-image.tsx`, no `app/blog/[slug]/opengraph-image.tsx`. `generateMetadata` in `app/(marketing)/[slug]/page.tsx:153-168` sets `openGraph` title/description/url but deliberately no `images`, so every one of the 765 programmatic pages shares the single root card. A per-family OG image would be a new `opengraph-image.tsx` in that family's route dir, modelled on the root one.
- `app/icon.png` is the only other metadata image file.

## Summary of gaps worth knowing before you build

1. **No shared `BreadcrumbJsonLd`** — only an inline literal at `app/(marketing)/[slug]/page.tsx:186-200`.
2. **No `images` config in `next.config.ts`** — `next/image` with remote mod icons will throw.
3. **No sitemap index / `generateSitemaps()`** — single `/sitemap.xml`, `force-dynamic`, hardcoded in `app/robots.ts:18`.
4. **`recordAudit` (`lib/audit.ts:15`) is the intended shared audit writer**, but `actions-nodes.ts` and 7 other modules still use private `audit()` copies that skip impersonation attribution.
5. **No `DataTable`/`AdminTable` and no toast system** — `BulkTable` (2 call sites) or a hand-rolled `.table-shell` inside a `.card`, plus inline status text.
6. **`feature_admin_agency` / `feature_admin_ads` have no settings-panel control** despite gating whole nav sections.
7. **Two different `FaqJsonLd` exports** with incompatible props (`StructuredData.tsx:154` takes `items`, `ToolShell.tsx:214` takes `faq`).
